item.title: Ivanti Neurons for MDM - degradation - https://ap1.mobileiron.com/- 2007380 [resolved]
IRW PRD - Workflow Slowness [resolved]
item.description:
No further instances of workflow slowness have been observed within the IRW PRD Landscape, and processing times have remained stable. As a result, this issue is now considered resolved.
As part of our investigation, we have identified opportunities for infrastructure improvements, which will be implemented to further enhance platform resilience and reduce the risk of similar issues occurring in the future.
We will continue to review the incident, and a Root Cause Analysis (RCA) will be provided when available. Thank you for your patience throughout this investigation.
